tools.name: list_esim_providers
tools.description: Search and list eSIM providers available in Kenya, with pricing, ratings, coverage, and descriptive fields (best_for, ideal_for/not_ideal_for, pros/cons). Optionally filter by a Kenya destination slug (national park, city, airport, beach, or island) to see providers editorially recommended there, wi

tools.name: get_esim_provider
tools.description: Get full details for a single eSIM provider by slug, including its review summary/verdict, key facts, FAQs, and every available plan (data amount, duration, price in USD). Use list_esim_providers first to find a provider slug.

tools.name: compare_esim_providers
tools.description: Compare two eSIM providers by slug. Returns esimkenya.com's curated head-to-head verdict when one exists for that pair, otherwise returns both providers' full details side by side so you can compare them yourself. Use list_esim_providers first to find provider slugs.
